title: staged-rollback-with-dependency-graph-and-state-seed-preservation
author: Asha Mehta
description: Context: customers running Private deployments reported rare failures when performing multi-stage upgrades where component inter-dependencies (schema, config, seed data) required coordinated rollbacks. Motivation: provide a safe, testable staged rollback path that understands service dependency ordering and preserves tenant-visible seeded state so that partial rollbacks do not leave the cluster in an inconsistent or unbootable condition. What this PR does: 1) Introduces a reversible dependency graph used by the installer to compute rollback stages; edges cover DB migrations, config map velocity, helm chart ordering, and tenant seed/data artifacts. 2) Adds ‘seed-preserve’ mode: when enabled, pre-rollback hooks snapshot tenant-seeded objects (application-level seeds and lightweight KV entries) into encrypted, versioned manifests stored in object storage with a TTL and rotation policy. 3) Implements a staged rollback executor that runs rollback stages in reverse topological order with signal checkpoints so operators can pause between stages and run integration smoke tests. 4) Adds a cli subcommand “installer rollback-plan --dry-run” that emits a human-readable plan and an operator-safe JSON plan; the JSON includes per-stage healthchecks and required preconditions. 5) Adds automatic downgrade guard checks that prevent application binary downgrades if schema compatibility checks fail; these checks are pluggable to allow product teams to opt-in. 6) Adds telemetry events and RBAC-scoped audit logs for each rollback stage and seed snapshot operation. Checklist: [x] design doc linked (Linear: ENG-2345) [x] unit tests for plan generator and serializer [x] integration test harness for staged executor using local Vagrant cluster [x] end-to-end dry-run validated against a sample two-tenant cluster [x] documented operational playbook and CLI usage (docs/installer/rollback.md) Testing notes: dry-run and encrypted snapshot creation were exercised against a local postgres instance and minio; tests include simulated partial failure (post-stage failure) and observed automatic resume/retry behavior. Compatibility: default behavior is opt-out; installer flags preserved for existing installs. Rollout plan: feature behind feature flag enabled by default for new private installs, and behind opt-in for existing customers; will be gated by a 2-week beta with selected customers. Rollback plan: staged executor supports resume-from-stage and manual abort; seed-preserve manifests can be used to restore tenant seeds if automated rollback cannot complete. Related work: complements earlier safe-rollback and migration-preview tooling. Security: snapshots are encrypted with customer-provided KMS keys when available; rotation TTL of 30 days by default. Limitations: not targeted at large binary data restores (those remain outside scope); heavy tenant-count clusters may need longer pause windows. Migration path: installer will validate cluster state and optionally recommend a canary rollback before full rollback. Links: design doc https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-2345, sample plan output in PR files. Commit summary: a) add dependency-graph package and graph serialization; b) implement plan generator and JSON emitter; c) implement staged executor with pause/resume; d) seed snapshotter and encryption layer; e) CLI flags and documentation; f) integration tests and telemetry hooks; g) unit tests and mocks. Files changed (high level): installer/cmd/rollback.go; installer/pkg/depgraph/* (new); installer/pkg/seedshot/* (new); installer/pkg/executor/staged.go; docs/installer/rollback.md; charts/redwood/values.rollback.yaml; scripts/e2e/rollback-smoke.sh; proto/installer/audit.proto; Makefile updates. Review conversation summary: initial review requested a smaller default TTL and clearer UI for pause/resume. Connor: "Please make TTL configurable and ensure KMS fallback behavior is explicit in logs." Author: "Made TTL configurable via --snapshot-ttl and added KMS fallback log lines; tests updated." Mateo: "Executor should surface stage-level metrics for SLOs." Author: "Added basic counters and trace spans; will iterate on dashboards in a follow-up." Sana: "Does this change the default behavior for existing installs?" Author: "No, default opt-out for upgrades; new installs get opt-in true but flagged in release notes." CI: pipeline ran unit, lint, and integration jobs; one flaky e2e job failed initially and was re-run; final CI green. Merge outcome: squash-merged to main after approvals and green CI. Release notes: "Added staged rollback support with dependency-aware execution and optional seed-state preservation. New CLI tools: installer rollback-plan and installer rollback --resume. Snapshots are encrypted with KMS when configured. Opt-in for existing clusters."
